run_env: run the hf env command to print information about the current environment
run_version: run the hf version command to print the installed huggingface_hub version
run_update: run the hf update command to update the hf CLI to the latest version
review_env: review the env function that prints environment information via dump_environment_info
review_update: review the update function that checks for and applies huggingface_hub CLI updates
